verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published VRAM capacity or memory bandwidth figures for the RX 9070 XT itself, nor any benchmark/claim that a 70B-class quantized model runs on it; the only VRAM reference (docs-12) speaks generically about 'up to 48GB' on unspecified Radeon workstation GPUs, not this card. Known consumer RX 9000-series cards ship far less VRAM than needed for 70B-class inference, and nothing in the pack claims otherwise for this specific SKU.
